item.title: 25-Years-Owned 1982 Porsche 911SC Targa
item.description: This 1982 Porsche 911SC Targa has remained registered on the East Coast since new and was purchased by the seller in 2001. It is finished in Guards Red over replacement black upholstery and is powered by a 3.0-liter flat-six paired with a five-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes a whale tail rear spoiler, a short shifter, 16" Fuchs wheels, a removable roof panel, air conditioning, and a Blaupunkt Miami CD stereo. item.description: This 2001 BMW M3 coupe was optioned with the Luxury, Cold Weather, and Power Seat packages, and it has been fitted with 18" Apex wheels, BC Racing suspension, and an aftermarket exhaust system. Finished in Titanium Silver Metallic over gray Nappa leather, the car is powered by a 3.2-liter inline-six linked with a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.description: This 1993 Ford Mustang is a GT convertible that was initially delivered to Holiday Motor Corporation of Blacksburg, Virginia, and it spent nine years with its first owner and 15 years with its second owner before it was purchased in 2020 by the seller, who has added approximately 1,700 of the 26k miles shown. item.title: 37k-Mile 2005 Mercedes-Benz SL65 AMG Anniversary Edition
item.description: This 2005 Mercedes-Benz SL65 AMG is an SL65 Anniversary Edition example that has 37k miles and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 6.0-liter V12 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission. The car is finished in Silver Arrow Metallic over Black Designo leather and is equipped with a power-retractable hardtop, bi-xenon headlights, Parktronic parking sensors, 19" two-piece alloy wheels, heated and ventilated multi-contour seats, a wind deflector, a Bose sound system, and COMAND with navigation.

item.title: 1967 Mercedes-Benz 250SE Cabriolet
item.description: This 1967 Mercedes-Benz 250SE cabriolet is a European-market example that spent years in Arizona prior to its purchase by the current owner on BaT in December 2022. It wears a repaint in Havana Brown over a Cognac leather interior with burled walnut-wood accents, and it is powered by a 2.5-liter inline-six linked with a four-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 2019 Ferrari 812 Superfast
item.description: This 2019 Ferrari 812 Superfast was specified in Rosso Corsa over Nero leather, and it has been registered in California and Nevada from new. item.description: This 2000 BMW M5 is powered by a 4.9-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transmission and is finished in Imola Red over Caramel Nappa Heritage leather. It is equipped with 18" Style 65 wheels, a limited-slip differential, a sunroof, xenon headlights, fog lights, heated power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, navigation, a cassette stereo, and a BMW-branded carphone. item.description: This '32 Ford is a Brookville steel-bodied, full-fendered roadster was built and modified over a period of several years during previous ownership. item.title: 1972 Chevrolet Corvette Coupe LT-1 4-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1972 Chevrolet Corvette is one of a claimed 240 examples equipped with a 350ci LT-1 V8 as well as factory air conditioning and is finished in white over a Saddle leather interior. Additional equipment includes a Muncie four-speed manual transmission, 15″ Rally wheels, four-wheel disc brakes, a Delco AM/FM radio, and body-color removable roof panels.
